  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  January 24, 2022

Meeting Place:  Call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
  Meeting ID: 960 5053 9618
  Passcode: 017243
  Time: 9:30 am

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the December 13, 2021, meeting.

  2. WPU Inc – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing services to
  the Inglewood Police Department.

  3. It’s Your Party – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing services
  for District One.

  4. Weck Laboratories, Inc – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for services
  of performing water analysis and lab testing for our water.

  5. Sunbelt Rentals, Inc – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for services
  provided for the city’s Halloween Spooktacular event.

  6. Kimberly Dodson – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for services
  provided for event planning for the 2022 Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Day Celebration
  Parade that was later canceled due to the ongoing pandemic.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.
  Distribution
  Brenneman D.
  Thompson A.

City of Inglewood

  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  February 07, 2022

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting
ID: 960 5053 9618 Passcode: 017243 at 9:35 am.

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office

  Staff Present:  Ely, Brandon, Public Works
  Heaney Maria, Finance
  Wilcox. Mindy, Planning
  Williams, Angela, Public Works
  Soto, Isabel, Housing

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of January 24, 2022, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Confunkshun – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for performing at the Taste
  of Inglewood Big Game Concerts Series Festival in the amount of $240.00. Motion carried
  unanimously.

  3. Roto-Rooter Services Company – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing emergency rooter drain clearing services at City Hall in the amount of $440.00.
  Motion carried unanimously.

  4. The Arroyo Group – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for services provided
  for Planning work in the amount of $5,000.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  5. CVR Associates, Inc – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for professional and
  advisory services for the Project Based Vouchers in the amount of $1,400.00. Motion carried
  unanimously.
 Claims Review Committee  February 07, 2022

  6. Language People – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for translating
  documents per the California Legislature SB998 $4,696.58. Motion carried unanimously

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 9:46 a.m.

Adjournment
